description: This file defines the DataSeries class used for handling different types of chart data series within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including constants for chart types, grouping, direction, styles, and methods for managing series properties and refreshing data.

classes.name: DataSeries
classes.description: Represents a data series for charts in PhpSpreadsheet, including constants for types and styles, properties for series attributes, and methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new DataSeries instance with specified chart type, grouping, series order, labels, categories, values, direction, style, and smoothing options.

methods.name: getPlotType
methods.description: Returns the type of the data series (e.g., bar chart, line chart).

methods.name: setPlotType
methods.description: Sets the type of the data series.

methods.name: getPlotGrouping
methods.description: Returns the grouping type of the series (e.g., clustered, stacked).

methods.name: setPlotGrouping
methods.description: Sets the grouping type of the series.

methods.name: getPlotDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the series (e.g.,col, bar).

methods.name: setPlotDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction of the series.

methods.name: getPlotOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of plots in the series.

methods.name: getPlotLabels
methods.description: Returns the labels for the data series.

methods.name: getPlotLabelByIndex
methods.description: Returns a specific label by index.

methods.name: getPlotCategories
methods.description: Returns the categories for the data series.

methods.name: getPlotCategoryByIndex
methods.description: Returns a specific category by index.

methods.name: getPlotStyle
methods.description: Returns the style of the plot.

methods.name: setPlotStyle
methods.description: Sets the style of the plot.

methods.name: getPlotValues
methods.description: Returns the plot values.

methods.name: getPlotValuesByIndex
methods.description: Returns plot values at a specific index.

methods.name: getPlotBubbleSizes
methods.description: Returns sizes of bubbles in bubble charts.

methods.name: setPlotBubbleSizes
methods.description: Sets sizes of bubbles in bubble charts.

methods.name: getPlotSeriesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of series in the plot values.

methods.name: getSmoothLine
methods.description: Returns whether the series is smoothed.

methods.name: setSmoothLine
methods.description: Sets whether the series should be smoothed.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the data series in the context of the specified worksheet.
